summary.value: Arthouse Hotel is a Boutique Hotel on the Upper West Side whose century-old building keeps its character (the hotel says our century-old building retains many of its historic accents), with three on-site restaurants and bars and the natural history museum a mere two blocks away from our property. It suits museum-and-park travelers who like a lively lobby scene; Tripadvisor's review summary says it is favorably located near Central Park and the subway. Honest watch-outs from the same summary: guests flag the music too loud, experiences with housekeeping and room size vary, and some travelers feel the hotel is overpriced with limited amenities.

description.value: Arthouse Hotel is a Boutique Hotel on the Upper West Side, and the hotel says its century-old building retains many of its historic accents. Rooms start with a Standard Queen of approximately 240 square feet, and the hotel lists three on-site restaurants and bars, including Serafina and RedFarm. Its neighborhood page puts the American Museum of Natural History a mere two blocks away. Tripadvisor rates it 4.2 Good (8,181), and its review summary says guests like the location near Central Park and the subway and the lively atmosphere. Watch-outs from the same summary: the music can be too loud for some, room size and housekeeping vary, and some feel it is overpriced with limited amenities; Booking.com scores it 7.9 overall with Location 9.2.
